text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, invited by Red Desire,
we visited a flea market being held in the park.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy you could join me.
I enjoy browsing through events like this, you see.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Actually, from time to time, I search places like this
for items that might prove useful in the Otherworld...
Now, shall we be on our way, Trainer?♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"My, what a lovely key...
And I can feel a mysterious power from it."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Maybe there's a door in an alternate world that fits this key?
Behind it must lie a relic of the ancient saintess...
Let's go buy it right away...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"This lantern...
Its powerful light feels so reassuring, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"There will surely be times when exploring caves or ruins is part of a Saint's trials.
I'll buy this one too...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
I found so many wonderful items.
choice_data_list: You're all set for the saintess's journey, huh.
You're all set for the saintess's journey, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, everything is going swimmingly♪
Next, let's head over to that area for new encounters—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good day.
I didn't realize you were here as well, Chrono-san.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
Desire-san, Trainer-san.
H-Hello.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Did you come to this flea market
looking for something too, Chrono-san?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Um,
I was looking for documents and materials on old races.
You can find things here that normal shops don't carry, so...
choice_data_list: Old race archives, huh? I'd like to take a look too.
Old race archives, huh? I'd like to take a look too.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In that case, would you like to explore together?
We were just in the middle of browsing shops too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! I-If I wouldn't be intruding, by all means...
I would love to join you...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-san?
Did you happen to find a rare gem?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um... I think I'll look around for a bit longer.
Please feel free to go ahead without me, you two.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, could it be...
you're feeling self-conscious about that camera over there?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "Ah, y-yes... I thought that perhaps it might be something you'd been interested in for a while..."

text_block_list.name: Camera Seller
text_block_list.text:
Hoh. You've got an eye for quality, little lady.
This one right here is what you'd call a classic masterpiece.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I knew it...!
Though it takes effort being fully manual, it has a reputation for offering expressive depth that makes it worthwhile...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
When I saw the photos taken with this camera,
I was completely captivated by their vividness, too...!
To think I'd actually encounter the real thing—

text_block_list.name: Camera Seller
text_block_list.text:
"It's an older model, and they don't pop up on the market very often.
Now's the time to buy! What do ya say, little lady?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely regret it if I don't buy it here...
Ugh, what should I do...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me, shopkeeper.
May I pick up this camera
and take a look at it?"

text_block_list.name: Camera Seller
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I don't mind.
Just handle it with care, please.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
...Chrono, why don't you try out the camera?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Eh, are you sure?
If you'll let me give it a try, I'd love to...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
J-Just touching it makes me nervous...
It's heavier than it looks,
and the lever feels a bit stiff—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...H-Huh? It's not working well...
Is adjusting the exposure that tricky...?

text_block_list.name: Camera Seller
text_block_list.text: Well, frankly, it is a finicky camera. But that's why the user's skill shows so clearly... It's a classic masterpiece precisely because of quirks like that.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...
Maybe it's beyond my ability to handle.
But... if I miss this chance...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Waiting patiently without rushing
might be an option as well.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Everyone walks their own path,
and everyone's pace is different.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you believe in yourself and keep making the effort,
you'll reach your ideal future someday.
That much is certain...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So... there is no need to rush.
Believing and biding one's time is also a valid choice.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Even if not right now... surely someday—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'll... study photography a lot more.
So that I can become someone worthy of such a masterpiece...!

text_block_list.name: Camera Seller
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
As long as you hold onto those feelings, little lady,
fate will surely bring you together again.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I'm praying for you too, Chrono-san...
that you overcome your trials and master the camera...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
Thank you so much for the advice!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Fufu... It has been a truly fruitful time. Being able to share this joy with you, Trainer, and lend a hand to Chrono-san as well—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Believing in yourself and continuing to put in the effort.
That is a core conviction of my own as well.
choice_data_list: She seemed just like a real saint.
I'll do my best with the exact same feeling.
I'll do my best with the exact same feelings.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Believing in yourself and continuing to put in the effort.
That is a core conviction of my own as well.
choice_data_list: She seemed just like a real saint.
I'll do my best with the exact same feeling.
I'll do my best with the exact same feelings.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course♪
As I always say, I am a true and genuine saintess...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And Trainer-san is someone who understands
my path as a saint more deeply than anyone else...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Having your words by my side is most reassuring.
I shall devote myself even more diligently to these trials.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much.
Having someone who shares the same aspirations
is truly encouraging...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And so that we can one day achieve our ideals...
Let us overcome these trials together♪
